newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telepizza IPO ends 46 times oversubscribed - BBV.
newsitem.headline: Telepizza IPO ends 46 times oversubscribed - BBV.

text.p: Spanish pizza delivery chain Telepizza's initial public offering was oversubscribed 46 times, lead manager BBV Interactivos said on Friday.
Demand was 477 billion pesetas on Friday compared with 60 billion on Monday, BBV said in a statement.
Demand for the retail tranche was 57 billion pesetas, with an average of 1.64 million pesetas per applicant.
Spanish institutional investor demand was 188 billion pesetas, 154 times the amount on offer, while international institutions applied for 231 billion, 56 times the offer.
The allocation price will be fixed on Sunday and Telepizza shares will begin trading on November 13. BBV predicted a large pro-rata allocation as the result of heavy demand.
